sources.articleTitle: Author Jojo Moyes among UK travellers at risk of EU ban amid digital border system glitches

headline: Author Jojo Moyes Faces Potential EU Travel Ban Amid System Errors
seoTitle: Jojo Moyes Faces EU Ban Over Border System Glitches
metaDescription: British author Jojo Moyes and other UK travelers face potential EU entry bans due to technical errors in the bloc's digital border record system.
aiSummaryBullets: Author Jojo Moyes is at risk of a two-year EU travel ban and significant fines.
Technical errors in the European Union's digital entry and exit system have inaccurately flagged some UK visitors.
The European Union has initiated legal action against IBM and two other firms regarding the border system's functionality.
aiContextParagraph: Since the United Kingdom's departure from the European Union, British citizens are subject to a 90-day limit for travel within the Schengen Area. The European Union recently implemented a digital entry and exit security system designed to track border crossings and ensure compliance with these regulations. However, reports have emerged indicating that technical glitches within this digital framework are incorrectly flagging some UK travelers for overstaying their allowed duration. Among those affected is author Jojo Moyes, who faces a potential two-year travel ban and a fine of €10,000 due to these record-keeping errors. In response to the persistent technical issues, the European Union has launched a lawsuit against IBM and two additional European technology firms, citing problems with the border system's implementation and operation. Affected travelers remain concerned about the accuracy of the automated tracking logs as the situation remains under legal review.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to public interest in the travel experiences of a well-known public figure amidst broader concerns regarding post-Brexit border procedures.
